versions.changelog:
**Summary:**  
Major skill revision with stricter rules, new multilingual support, and extensive validation gates for reliable, production-ready storefront scaffolding.

- Introduced strict IRON RULES (e.g., even-pixel font sizes ≥12px, lucide-react icons only, no emoji in UI) enforced by automated gate scripts.
- Added comprehensive English/Chinese descriptions; locale-detection directs UI language and output; all references, output, code, and validation scripts updated accordingly.
- Significantly expanded output validation (e.g., file existence, naming, placeholder removal, content structure, live image checks, enforced palette scales, route coverage) through new scripting.
- Restructured documentation for clarity, listing exhaustive procedural steps, mandatory file tree, interface contracts, and handoff/proof expectations.
- Numerous new files added for multilingual documentation, image assets, scripts, and code structure templates; obsolete content and English-only docs removed.
- Output delivery now requires all build and content gates to pass, ensuring each generated storefront is immediately runnable and production-worthy.

**Added automatic locale detection and Chinese/English UI scaffolding support.**

- Skill now detects user's system locale before scaffolding and generates all UI strings in Simplified Chinese if locale is zh-*, otherwise defaults to English.
- All user-facing content (navigation, product names, descriptions, buttons, checkout, admin, etc.) now translated according to language conventions.
- `products.ts` now requires both `name` (zh) and `nameEn` (English) fields in zh mode.
- Added `clsx` as a required dependency.
- Updated documentation and conventions to mandate language detection and i18n as top priority.
- static image fetch from https://github.com/lwter/neway-commerce-os/tree/master/templates/base/static/images

New skill for scaffolding modern e-commerce sites using React, Vite, Hono, and EdgeOne.

- Instantly generates a full-featured storefront skeleton from a short product brief.
- Outputs production-ready file structure, including all required pages, components, and API functions.
- Enforces strict code conventions for fonts, icons (lucide-react only), image checks, and even-numbered typography.
- Integrates Zustand-based persistent cart, Stripe-style payment API stubs, and full admin/dashboard tools.
- All generated code is ready for EdgeOne Pages deployment with TypeScript checked at build.
